channel.title: Caribbean National Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Caribbean National Weekly (caribbeannationalweekly.com)

item.title: Ambergris Cay in Turks and Caicos unveils new waterside bungalows, villas, and expanded estate - CNW Network
item.description: Ambergris Cay has announced a major expansion of its accommodations, introducing 12 new Waterside Bungalows, two new villas, and more.

item.title: Sunrise Airways launches historic direct flights between Cap-Haïtien and Boston - CNW Network
item.description: Haitian airline Sunrise Airways has inaugurated a new direct route connecting Cap-Haïtien (CAP) and Boston (BOS).

item.title: DGM deports over 67,000 undocumented immigrants through Haiti border in two months - CNW Network
item.description: DGM in the Dominican Republic reported that 30,799 foreigners were deported through border crossings with Haiti in February.

item.title: FID warns Jamaicans against using bank accounts for criminal activities - CNW Network
item.description: The Financial Investigations Division (FID) issued a warning to Jamaicans against allowing their accounts to be used for criminal activities.

item.title: Antigua Opposition leader Jamale Pringle denies reports of resignation - CNW Network
item.description: Jamale Pringle, Leader of the Opposition in Antigua and Barbuda, has strongly rejected recent claims suggesting he intends to step down.

item.title: Guyana Opposition leader seeks CCJ intervention to halt extradition to the US - CNW Network
item.description: Guyana's Azruddin Mohamed has filed an urgent application with CCJ seeking special leave to appeal last week’s ruling.

item.title: Jamaican priest aentenced to 12 years for sexual offences against minor - CNW Network
item.description: A 41-year-old Catholic priest was sentenced to 12 years in prison after being found guilty of having sexual intercourse with a minor.

item.title: Hard Rock Heals Foundation raises JMD$62 million for Jamaica's hurricane recovery - CNW Network
item.description: The Hard Rock Heals Foundation, the charitable arm of Hard Rock International, has raised US$400,000 (J$62.8 million) to support Jamaica.

item.title: UN report warns of expanding gang control and excessive force in Haiti - CNW Network
item.description: Deadly gangs in Haiti are extending their influence over critical sea and road routes, according to a new UN human rights report.

item.title: Audrey Marks to receive President’s Award at Right Now for Jamaica inaugural gala - CNW Network
item.description: The Honorable Audrey Marks will be honored with the inaugural President’s Award by Right Now for Jamaica's first-ever Gala Dinner & Concert.
